Title: ICyrenaPersistenceBuilder - Persistence Store Registration
Summary: Builder interface for registering entity stores during DI configuration. Supports scoped (per-chat) and singleton (app-wide) store registration.
Content:
## ICyrenaPersistenceBuilder

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Persistence.Options`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Persistence.Core`
**Version**: 0.4.0

### Purpose
Helper interface for registering entity stores during DI configuration. Extensions that provide concrete persistence implementations (e.g., `Cyrena.Persistence.File`) register an implementation of this interface in `CyrenaBuilder.FeatureOptions`. Extension developers then use `CyrenaBuilder.AddScopedStore<TEntity>()` or `AddSingletonStore<TEntity>()` which delegate to this builder.

### Interface Definition

```csharp
public interface ICyrenaPersistenceBuilder
{
    void AddScopedStore<TEntity>(string collectionName) where TEntity : class, IEntity;
    void AddSingletonStore<TEntity>(string collectionName) where TEntity : class, IEntity;
}
```

### Methods

#### AddScopedStore<TEntity>(string collectionName)
Registers `IStore<TEntity>` as a **scoped** service (one instance per chat/kernel scope).

- `TEntity`: Entity type implementing `IEntity`
- `collectionName`: Logical collection/table name used by the persistence backend

#### AddSingletonStore<TEntity>(string collectionName)
Registers `IStore<TEntity>` as a **singleton** service (single application-wide instance).

- `TEntity`: Entity type implementing `IEntity`
- `collectionName`: Logical collection/table name used by the persistence backend

### Usage

This interface is not called directly by extension developers. Instead, use the extension methods on `CyrenaBuilder`:

```csharp
// In extension BuildExtension method
builder.AddScopedStore<MyData>("my-data");
builder.AddSingletonStore<GlobalConfig>("global-config");
```

- `CyrenaBuilder.AddSingletonStore<TEntity>()` — Extension method that delegates to this builder

- `IEntity` — Base entity interface from `Cyrena.Core`
